claims.claim: Old Rectangular black tempered glass center table
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a dark tinted rectangular glass top with etched design, consistent with a center table top, but 'tempered' cannot be confirmed from a photo, and 'old' conflicts with the seller's later claim of being bought new last year.

claims.claim: Legs for standing the tape are not included
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the glass top with corner brackets, no frame or legs visible.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm, from a smoke-free home
claims.evidence: These descriptors (stain, tear, foam) apply to upholstered furniture, not a glass tabletop; the witness report shows only a glass panel with no fabric or padding, so this claim does not match the item shown.

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's description (foam, stain, tear) and the actual item (glass top) suggests a copy-pasted or wrong listing text, raising doubt about what is truly being sold.
risks.proof: A fresh photo or short video of the exact item with the seller holding a dated note or ID, showing only the glass top and matching the description given.
risks.if_unproven: treat as unverified identity match, price at worst case as a bare glass top only, no bundled legs or extras

risks.risk: Edge chips or cracks not visible in the single leaning shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all four edges and corners in good light.

risks.risk: Unknown dimensions and thickness, affecting fit and value.
risks.proof: Photo of a tape measure against the length, width, and edge thickness.
risks.if_unproven: price at smallest common center-table glass size and thinnest standard thickness

risks.risk: No table frame/base included, so buyer must source one separately.
risks.proof: Explicit confirmation photo or video showing only the glass being sold, no base in another room.
risks.if_unproven: price as glass-top-only, excluding any frame value

risks.risk: Underside scratches or stress marks not visible from the leaning angle.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside laid flat.
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically worst-case on unseen side

proof_requests: Close-up photos of all four glass edges and corners
Photo with a tape measure showing length, width, and thickness
Photo of the underside of the glass laid flat
A current photo/video of the seller with the item and a dated handwritten note
Clarification on why the description mentions foam, stains, and tears for a glass item
response.reason: The seller's wording describes attributes of upholstered furniture (stain, tear, foam) that cannot apply to the glass tabletop the witness actually saw, indicating either a copy-pasted scam listing or a seriously mismatched description that must be resolved before any price is set.
